t: Около 20 тыс. человек остались без света из-за атаки БПЛА в Ленобласти
d: Около 20 тыс. человек остались без электричества в результате атаки беспилотников Вооруженных сил Украины (ВСУ) на Ленинградскую область, сообщил 18 октября губернатор региона. Новость дополняется
te: About 20 thousand people were left without electricity because of the attack of the UAV in the Leningrad region
de: About 20 thousand people were left without electricity as a result of the attack by drones of the Armed Forces of Ukraine (AFU) on the Leningrad region, the governor of the region said on October 18. The news is supplemented.

te: A woman and three children were hospitalized in the Leningrad region after the fall of the wreckage of the UAV
de: A woman and three children were hospitalized in the Leningrad region after the fall of the wreckage of a drone on the house. On October 18, the head of the region Alexander Drozdenko said. In the Vsevolozhsky district after falling on a residential house of the wreckage of the UAV occurred…
